title: is industy 4.0 the key to sustainable manufacturing? unravelling the impact of innovation and continuous improvement in emerging economies
core_idea: Examine how Industry 4.0 technologies influence business sustainability in manufacturing within emerging economies by analyzing the combined effects of organisational innovation and continuous improvement, and how I4.0 adoption amplifies these relationships using structural equation modeling on survey data from 200 companies.
tldr: Investigates whether and how Industry 4.0 adoption interacts with organisational innovation and continuous improvement to shape business sustainability in manufacturing firms in emerging economies, using SEM analysis of data from 200 companies.
